display_name: 输入相关投影修正上限恢复器：保留并发余量版本
description: 与被资源停止的 r01 相同的从零单阶段30轮有界投影网络；仅调整队列准入和本任务进程数保护。

data.representation: Original R07 L_s6300/U_s56700 paired clean/received IQ and simulated Action/noise; original source mean/covariance.
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels. Original physical Action/noise supervision and corrected source noiseless IQ/STFT/.01 continuous frozen F0 features.
data.augmentation: Original R07 clean+six source scenes and original 30-draw order; no new source or target data.

permissions.query_use: Physical branch uses original source simulator factors only. Detail branch uses source clean and continuous frozen F0 on the corrected source noiseless inverse. Main uses only received IQ and a frozen original F0 head.
permissions.claim_scope: Fixed per-record correction cap uses only received IQ at deployment; no true Action, noise, clean, TX, F0 logits/CE, V/OE or target training.

checkpoint.initialization: All5481223 G parameters from scratch, identical r01 initialization; no r01 or other G weights or optimizer states loaded.
sources: FROZEN_F0 original source Tri-SIG-TIME SSL and legal source mean/covariance.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Same original R07 source L_s/U_s and frozen original F0/moments. Original r01 stopped at0 epochs and no target; actual model math unchanged from f817.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Scratch G with source physical and F0 continuous guidance only. No TX/V/OE/target training or parent learned state.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final30/7410 only, all Main seven-view predictions of both populations before independent truth-last.

metric_names: Original frozen ground Tri-SIG-TIME SSL Main168000: raw clean145385; each practical>=140345 and both raw clean populations separately maintained.
Original clean and six practical, per TX/RX/day groups, paired raw/DURA repairs and damage. Original ProjectedPriorDetail matched control only after all predictions fixed.
Every source epoch: unbounded and bounded projected correction NMSE, actual clipping fraction/scale, source losses, optimizer norms, posterior residual, wall time and memory.
5481223 learned parameters unchanged; bound is on per-record correction L2, not parameter count. Track source and actual deployed effect, not inferred speed.
dimensions: original Main two populations and seven views

rows.purpose: Test whether controlling rare extreme learned posterior corrections improves source stability and frozen-F0 Main identification.

notes: R01 source2 passed but before any completed epoch another worker registered a GPU context, raising GPU4 total from3 to4. Only r01 owner and child were stopped; other tasks and all outputs preserved, zero target predictions.
